records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Algebraic Expressions and Equations
records.summary: Substitute known quantities, preserve equivalence when manipulating expressions or equations, and distinguish a variable value from a formula or expression.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Angle Constraint Reasoning
records.summary: Use straight-line, triangle, parallel-line and equal-angle constraints to infer unmeasured angles in diagrams that need not be to scale.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Area Formula and Squared Units
records.summary: Choose perpendicular height, face count and squared unit conversions when relating lengths and areas.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Argand Region and Modulus Extremum
records.summary: A shaded intersection of a disc and half-plane is translated into simultaneous inequalities, then its farthest admissible boundary point determines maximum modulus.
uncertainties: Bounded source-derived concept candidate; no approved lab-idea alignment was verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Binomial Coefficient Constraints
records.summary: Learners may expand factors correctly in isolation but omit one cross-product when extracting a target coefficient from their product, or fail to connect the resulting coefficient condition to a quadratic constraint on a parameter.
uncertainties: Candidate derived from one linked three-part question; suitability and relationship to an interactive idea need separate review.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Circle–Line Intersection and Chord Distance
records.summary: Learners form a circle from a diameter, solve its intersection with a line, then use the two derived coordinates to find the chord distance.
uncertainties: Candidate is proposed because the existing circle-theorem concept does not describe coordinate circle-line intersection or a derived distance; no existing lab-idea mapping was verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Circle Tangents and Coordinate Area
records.summary: Analytic circle data determine tangent lines, axis intercepts and an intersection before a requested region area is calculated.
uncertainties: Source-supported concept candidate; no lab-idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Circle Theorem Constraint Network
records.summary: Learners may recognise individual circle-theorem diagrams but fail to decide which invariant applies when points move, or how E4.8 chord and tangent symmetry properties connect lengths, perpendicular bisectors and the centre to the angle theorems in E4.7.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Circular Boundary Perimeter
records.summary: Identify which curved and straight boundary pieces contribute to a perimeter before using radius, diameter and arc relations.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Complex Square-Root Sign Pairing
records.summary: Real and imaginary equations yield a quartic or equivalent squared-modulus system, with coupled signs determining the two exact complex roots.
uncertainties: Bounded source-derived concept candidate; no approved lab-idea alignment was verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Compound Boundary Measurement
records.summary: Joining shapes removes internal shared boundaries; perimeter counts only exposed edges.
uncertainties: Bounded source-derived candidate; no approved lab-idea alignment was verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Compound Measure Relations
records.summary: Relate a compound measure to its numerator and denominator quantities, as in speed, distance and time or density, mass and volume; rearrangement and compatible units determine the requested quantity.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Coordinate Distance, Midpoint and Perpendicular Lines
records.summary: Learners may apply the distance formula, midpoint averages and negative-reciprocal rule as separate formulas without seeing how the same two endpoints determine the segment's horizontal and vertical changes, length, midpoint and perpendicular bisector.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Straight-Line Coordinates, Equations and Parallel Lines
records.summary: Learners may plot from a table or read m and c as separate routines without connecting a coordinate point, gradient, intercept, equation and parallel displacement as linked descriptions of one straight line.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Curve Normal and Equal-Area Constraint
records.summary: Learners integrate a curve-defined shaded area, derive a normal at a supplied point, and solve for a horizontal level whose enclosed triangle has the same area.
uncertainties: Candidate spans differentiation and integration in one linked diagram; no existing lab-idea mapping was verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Derivative and Normal Equation
records.summary: A supplied point on a curve fixes where to evaluate the derivative; perpendicularity then determines the normal equation in the requested form.
uncertainties: Source-supported candidate; lab design and classification remain unapproved.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Exact Number Representation
records.summary: Non-calculator tasks connect equivalent index, standard-form and surd representations while retaining a requested exact or normalised form.
uncertainties: Bounded source-derived candidate; no approved lab-idea alignment was verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Fraction Equivalence and Arithmetic
records.summary: Equivalent representations, reciprocals and common denominators support numerical calculation with fractions and decimals, fractional shading and recovery of a whole from a known fraction.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Function Composition and Parameter Constraints
records.summary: Function order and domain conditions control inverse expressions, parameter equations and whether a composed equation has real roots.
uncertainties: Source-supported candidate; lab design and classification remain unapproved.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Function Table and Graph
records.summary: A function rule determines tabulated coordinates whose plotted points and appropriate curve connect algebraic and graphical representations.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Geometric Sequence Structure
records.summary: A constant multiplicative ratio controls both successive terms and an exponential nth-term expression; the first term fixes the exponent offset.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Geometrical Construction and Nets
records.summary: Use supplied dimensions and construction evidence to draw shapes, or preserve face dimensions and adjacency when unfolding a solid.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Geometrical Vocabulary
records.summary: Classify shapes and locate their components from defining properties rather than visual orientation or regularity.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Graph Region and Boundary Inclusion
records.summary: A graph region is an intersection of inequalities whose boundaries and strictness must be read from line style.
uncertainties: Bounded source-derived candidate; no approved lab-idea alignment was verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Grouped Mean Estimation
records.summary: Class midpoints represent unobserved values within grouped intervals; weighting by frequency and dividing by total frequency produces an estimated mean.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Histogram Area and Cumulative Distribution
records.summary: Learners may read histogram height as frequency when class widths differ, build cumulative frequency as disconnected running totals, or read quartiles from a curve without seeing how the same grouped observations determine bar area, cumulative growth and the uncertainty of estimated values.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Index Law Structure
records.summary: Interpret positive, zero, negative and fractional indices and recognise how powers combine under multiplication, division and powers of powers, separating a base from its exponent.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Inequality Interval Representation
records.summary: Open and closed endpoints distinguish excluded and included values when translating between interval statements and number lines.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Inverse Function Reversal
records.summary: An inverse function reverses input and output. Reversing the defining operations gives an inverse formula, while a relation f⁻¹(x) = a can be solved by evaluating f(a).
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Logarithmic Linearisation and Parameter Recovery
records.summary: Coordinates on a transformed graph constrain original-model constants; its ordinate is ln y, and the exponent on y scales both gradient and intercept.
uncertainties: Bounded source-derived concept candidate; no approved lab-idea alignment was verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Logarithmic Linear Form
records.summary: Power and quotient logarithm laws turn an exponential relation into a linear relation whose slope and intercept must retain the requested exact form.
uncertainties: Bounded assessment-evidence grouping; no lab idea or implementation link has been verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Rounded Measurement and Bounds
records.summary: Learners may treat a rounded measurement as an exact point and choose upper or lower inputs mechanically without considering which possible values make a derived result largest, smallest or decisively ordered.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Metric Unit Dimensions
records.summary: Conversion factors for lengths, areas and volumes depend on dimension; volume and capacity units also express the same quantity.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Modulus Equation Branches
records.summary: Equal absolute values require both sign branches or an equivalent squared equation; branches may supply later trigonometric equations.
uncertainties: Bounded assessment-evidence grouping; no lab idea or implementation link has been verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Modulus Inequality Regions
records.summary: Removing moduli produces critical values; the response must retain the correct union of strict regions, rather than just boundary values.
uncertainties: Bounded source-derived concept candidate; no approved lab-idea alignment was verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Motion Graph Rate and Area Relationships
records.summary: Learners may read coordinates from travel graphs without understanding gradient as speed or acceleration and, at Extended, area under a speed-time graph as accumulated distance.
uncertainties: No exact question-part link survived the paper-first migration; mapping remains pending.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Non-Right Triangle Solution Constraints
records.summary: Learners may select sine or cosine rule by formula pattern, overlook the side-angle pairing required by the sine rule, assume supplied SSA data makes exactly one triangle, or fail to connect the area formula to a perpendicular height and included angle.
uncertainties: Nine exact 0580 question-part records are mapped to this concept, but the bounded sample contains no direct SSA ambiguous-case item; classification of direct SSA demand remains pending.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Parametric Derivative and Gradient
records.summary: Differentiate coordinate functions with respect to their common parameter, form the derivative ratio and translate a supplied coordinate into the parameter needed for a gradient.
uncertainties: Bounded assessment-evidence grouping; no lab idea or implementation link has been verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Percentage Part and Whole
records.summary: Relate a percentage to its reference quantity and distinguish a part, the whole and an amount of change.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Place Value and Rounding
records.summary: Represent the same quantity in words, ordinary notation or standard form; rounding selects a specified place while estimation changes the calculation inputs.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Plane Area Composition
records.summary: Identify perpendicular dimensions and combine component areas while retaining square units.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Polynomial Constraints, Factors and Sign Regions
records.summary: Factor and derivative-remainder conditions determine coefficients, then complete factorisation supports a union of polynomial sign regions.
uncertainties: Bounded source-derived concept candidate; no approved lab-idea alignment was verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Polynomial Derivative and Gradient
records.summary: Differentiate a polynomial term by term and evaluate its derivative at a specified abscissa to obtain the local gradient.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea alignment verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Polynomial Quotient and Root Structure
records.summary: Division and the remainder identify factors of a shifted polynomial, linking a known linear root to an equation for another intercept.
uncertainties: Bounded assessment-evidence grouping; no lab idea or implementation link has been verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Powers and Roots Evaluation
records.summary: Evaluate numerical powers and roots while preserving the scope of brackets and radicals; zero, negative and fractional indices determine how a power is interpreted.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Prime Factor Structure of HCF and LCM
records.summary: Learners may perform factor trees and HCF or LCM procedures as separate routines without seeing that the prime factors common to both numbers determine the HCF, while the complete set needed to construct both numbers determines the LCM.
uncertainties: No exact question-part link survived the paper-first migration; mapping remains pending.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Probability Partitions and Complements
records.summary: Use exhaustive mutually exclusive outcomes and complementary probabilities to recover a missing outcome probability.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea alignment verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Proportional Function Calibration
records.summary: Translate direct or inverse proportionality to a relation containing a constant, use a known input-output pair to determine it, and retain the specified dependence in the resulting formula.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Quadratic-in-a-Function Solver
records.summary: Learners may treat a rational or higher-power equation as a new form rather than identify a repeated expression such as x², solve the resulting quadratic, and return to the original variable while retaining only permitted real values.
uncertainties: Candidate derived from one reviewed question; suitability and relationship to an interactive idea need separate review.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Quadratic Parameter, Repeated Root and Inverse Branch
records.summary: Learners use a parameterised quadratic to identify repeated roots, restrict a quadratic branch so it is one-one, and state the resulting inverse expression.
uncertainties: Candidate groups linked subparts of one examination question; the discriminant and inverse-domain requirements may instead be catalogued as separate concepts.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Ratio, Concentration and Flow Rate
records.summary: Learners may solve ratio and rate questions with separate unitary procedures without seeing that mixture composition and throughput must both remain consistent as batch size or flow changes.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Recurring Decimal and Fraction Structure
records.summary: Learners may memorise a subtraction procedure for recurring decimals without understanding why multiplying by a power of ten aligns the repeating tail or how denominator factors determine whether division terminates.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Relative Frequency, Bias and Expected Frequency
records.summary: Learners may treat an experimental proportion as an exact future probability, assume that a device is fair because its outcomes look balanced over a small run, or interpret an expected frequency as a guaranteed count rather than a long-run prediction that remains subject to random variation.
uncertainties: No exact question-part link survived the paper-first migration; mapping remains pending.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Repeated Integration by Parts
records.summary: A polynomial-exponential product needs repeated reduction before definite limits produce an exact value; coefficient matching offers an alternative antiderivative route.
uncertainties: Bounded source-derived concept candidate; no approved lab-idea alignment was verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Repeated Percentage Growth and Decay
records.summary: Learners may add repeated percentages or apply every change to the original amount, missing that each step changes the base and that reversing a percentage requires dividing by the multiplier.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Replacement and Conditional Sample Spaces
records.summary: Learners may multiply unchanged fractions mechanically even when an item is not replaced, confuse AND with OR when combining branches or regions, or fail to see conditional probability as a new denominator created by restricting attention to the outcomes consistent with known information.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Right-Triangle Ratio Invariance
records.summary: Learners may treat SOHCAHTOA as three unrelated mnemonics, choose a ratio from surface labels, or confuse an angle of elevation or depression with a non-horizontal reference instead of recognising that a fixed acute angle determines invariant side ratios across all similar right triangles.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Root Bracketing and Iteration
records.summary: Sign evidence brackets a root and a rearranged equation generates successive approximations whose displayed precision must justify the final rounding.
uncertainties: Bounded assessment-evidence grouping; no lab idea or implementation link has been verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Scale Drawing and Bearings
records.summary: Translate actual distance and clockwise-from-north bearing into measurements and locations on a scale drawing.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Scatter Correlation and Prediction
records.summary: Learners may classify correlation from a vague upward or downward impression, draw a line through convenient points rather than balancing the full data set, or use correlation and a fitted line to make causal or unsupported predictions beyond the observed range.
uncertainties: No exact question-part link survived the paper-first migration; mapping remains pending.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Sector and Triangle Boundary Composition
records.summary: Distinguish the arc and straight segments contributing to a shaded perimeter from sector-minus-triangle area.
uncertainties: Source-supported candidate; lab design and classification remain unapproved.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Sector Perimeter and Area Relations
records.summary: Arc length and sector area share a fraction of a circle; a supplied perimeter includes radii as well as the arc.
uncertainties: Bounded source-derived candidate; no approved lab-idea alignment was verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Separable Differential Equation and Branch Selection
records.summary: Variable separation and a derivative identity produce a particular implicit relation; the requested interval selects one inverse-trigonometric value at the target input.
uncertainties: Bounded source-derived concept candidate; no approved lab-idea alignment was verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Sequence Difference Structure
records.summary: Learners may guess nth terms from a few values without connecting constant first, second or third differences to linear, quadratic or cubic structure, or recognising when several formulas fit the visible prefix.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Set Membership and Operations
records.summary: Learners may manipulate union, intersection and complement symbols as isolated rules without checking every element against the defining conditions, especially when an item belongs to both sets or neither set.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Signed Number Operations
records.summary: Direction and magnitude distinguish a negative starting quantity, a change, and a difference between quantities.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Similarity Scale Effects
records.summary: Learners may use a linear scale factor correctly for corresponding lengths but apply the same factor to area, surface area or volume, without seeing why the number of independently scaled dimensions changes the exponent.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Solid Surface-Area and Volume Trade-offs
records.summary: Learners may select and apply a solid formula as an isolated routine without seeing how the same dimensions determine exposed surface area and internal volume differently, especially when a uniform cross-section is extended along a length.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Stationary-Point Constraints
records.summary: Stationary-point conditions may determine coordinates, constrain an unknown curve, supply integration bounds, or produce an equation to prove. These response roles differ even where the underlying condition dy/dx = 0 overlaps.
uncertainties: Four selected tasks support a bounded concept candidate; this is not a qualification-wide demand ranking or an approved lab mapping.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Statistical Displays and Summaries
records.summary: Read and complete displays while retaining category or place-value meaning, then choose and calculate a requested count or summary.
uncertainties: Assessment grouping only; no lab idea link verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Three-Dimensional Line-Plane Trigonometry
records.summary: Learners may apply Pythagoras to lengths that do not lie in one right triangle, read a perspective angle as the required angle, or fail to identify that the angle between a line and a plane is measured against the line's perpendicular projection on that plane.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Time-Zone and Timetable Constraints
records.summary: Learners may add clock offsets without tracking dates, elapsed duration, 12/24-hour notation or timetable constraints, causing errors when a journey or event crosses midnight or the International Date Line.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Transformation Order and Invariants
records.summary: Learners may identify a final image by appearance without connecting it to the defining mirror line, rotation centre, enlargement centre and scale factor, or translation vector. They may also assume that two transformations can be performed in either order with the same result, and may not interpret a negative scale factor as placing corresponding points on the opposite side of the centre.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Trapezium Estimate and Curvature
records.summary: A specified interval count determines sampled ordinates and trapezium weights; curve shape determines the direction of approximation error.
uncertainties: Bounded assessment-evidence grouping; no lab idea or implementation link has been verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Trigonometric Function Periodicity and Solutions
records.summary: Learners may sketch sine, cosine and tangent as remembered shapes or report only the calculator's principal inverse value, missing how symmetry, period, range and tangent asymptotes determine every solution in the interval 0° to 360°.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Vector Line Relation Consistency
records.summary: Two points determine a vector line, while distinct parameters and all three coordinate equations distinguish intersection from skewness.
uncertainties: Bounded source-derived concept candidate; no approved lab-idea alignment was verified.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Vector Routes and Resultants
records.summary: Learners may add vector components as an isolated rule without seeing that a vector is independent of position, subtraction reverses a displacement, scalar multiplication changes magnitude and possibly direction, and the resultant is the single displacement joining the start to the finish rather than the total distance travelled.
uncertainties: Concept links are provisional pending completion of the question repair ledger.

records.subject: mathematics
records.title: Volume of Revolution Between Curves
records.summary: Intersection limits and squared outer/inner radii define a volume by definite integration; this differs from a fixed-solid surface-area formula task.
uncertainties: Source-supported concept candidate; no lab-idea link verified.
